in_sanskrit.name: Duvisha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Difficulty, Misfortune, Obstacle
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Duvisha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'duh' meaning 'difficult' and 'kshaya' meaning 'destruction', Duvisha is a name that represents misfortune, obstacle, and difficulty in life. It is believed that the name holds the power to ward off evil and protect the bearer from all forms of misfortune and hardship.
